manageDeals.applyAllNote: This meal deal will be added to new events. For existing events, go to the “Schedule” tab to manage meal deals per event.
manageDeals.emptyBody: Create a meal deal, e.g. “Lunch combo — any pizza + drink + dip for {price}”
manageDeals.manualHelp: This meal deal will not appear on events unless you switch it on in the “Schedule” tab.
eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.missingTitle: Event types are not switched on yet.
eventTypes.missingBody: The database update for this feature has not been applied yet. Nothing is broken — every event uses your usual settings.
eventTypes.noTypes: You have no event types yet, so every event uses your usual settings.
eventTypes.name: Name
eventTypes.matchTitle: Make “{name}” the same as the Standard type?
eventTypes.matchKeeps: Anything you changed on a single event’s dashboard stays as it is, and this type’s prices are not changed.

eventTypes.phone.vanSetup: This vehicle’s usual settings — used at every event with no type.
eventTypes.phone.standardSetup: Your usual settings — used at every event with no type.

eventTypes.phone.noMenuItems: No menu items yet — add them in Menu › Items.
eventTypes.newType.title: New event type
eventTypes.newType.help: Tap a name or type your own. It starts as a copy of the Standard type, and later changes to Standard will not change it. You can change anything afterwards.
eventTypes.select.label: Event type
eventTypes.select.usual: The usual type for this place is: {name}.
eventTypes.errors.noVans: This food truck has no vehicles that can be changed.
privateEvents.grid.linkRowLabel: Take orders through a private link and QR code
privateEvents.grid.columnTitle: The built-in Private type. It cannot be renamed, moved or deleted.
privateEvents.form.help: On your schedule it shows as “Private event”, with only the date and time — never with the address, the map or on Village Foodie.
privateEvents.form.linkPromise: Guests order through a private link and QR code — you will get them after saving.
privateEvents.form.nameHelp: Guests see this at the top of the ordering page.
privateEvents.form.previewNote: How it shows on your schedule — no location, town or postcode.
privateEvents.form.needsTimes: Add a start and end time — a private event taking orders through a link must have them.
privateEvents.link.title: Private link and QR code
privateEvents.link.label: Private link
privateEvents.link.newLinkConfirm: Make a new link? The current link stops working immediately, and all QR codes you have already printed will stop working too.
privateEvents.link.newLinkHelp: Use this if the link has ended up where it should not. The current link stops working immediately, and printed QR codes stop working too.
privateEvents.link.newLinkFailed: A new link could not be made.
privateEvents.link.offNotice: Ordering through a private link is switched off for this event, so there is no link to share. The event still shows on your schedule as “Private event”.
privateEvents.cards.blurb: Order and pay on your phone. We will call you by name when it is ready.
privateEvents.noSinglePost: Private events do not get a separate post — they appear on your weekly poster as “Private event”.
privateEvents.confirmToPrivate: This hides the address and removes the event from the map. Guests will need the private link to order.
privateEvents.confirmFromPrivate: This makes the event public: its address and map pin will show, and the private link will stop working.
